import pandas as pd

file_path = '/data/national_programme_ledger.xlsx'

field_df = pd.read_excel(file_path, sheet_name='Field Expenses', header=4)
salary_df = pd.read_excel(file_path, sheet_name='Salary Register', header=5)
lookup_df = pd.read_excel(file_path, sheet_name='Cost Centre Lookup', header=3)

# Normalize lookup codes
lookup_codes = set()
for code in lookup_df['Cost Centre Code'].dropna():
    norm = str(code).strip().lower()
    lookup_codes.add(norm)

print("Lookup codes count:", len(lookup_codes))
print("Sample lookup codes:", list(lookup_codes)[:10])

# Helper normalization
def normalize_cc(val):
    if pd.isna(val):
        return ''
    return str(val).strip().lower()

def normalize_status(val):
    if pd.isna(val):
        return ''
    return str(val).strip().lower()

# Field expenses filtering
field_df['Transaction ID norm'] = field_df['Transaction ID'].astype(str).str.strip()
field_df['Cost Centre norm'] = field_df['Cost Centre'].apply(normalize_cc)
field_df['Posting Status norm'] = field_df['Posting Status'].apply(normalize_status)

field_mask = (
    field_df['Transaction ID norm'].str.startswith('FE-') &
    (field_df['Posting Status norm'] == 'posted') &
    field_df['Cost Centre norm'].isin(lookup_codes)
)

field_filtered = field_df[field_mask].copy()
print("\nField filtered count:", len(field_filtered))
print(field_filtered[['Transaction ID','Cost Centre','Posting Status','Amount (INR)']].head())

field_total = field_filtered['Amount (INR)'].sum()
print("Field total:", field_total)

# Salary filtering
salary_df['Payroll Line ID norm'] = salary_df['Payroll Line ID'].astype(str).str.strip()
salary_df['Cost Centre norm'] = salary_df['Cost Centre'].apply(normalize_cc)
salary_df['Payroll Status norm'] = salary_df['Payroll Status'].apply(normalize_status)

salary_mask = (
    salary_df['Payroll Line ID norm'].str.startswith('PAY-') &
    (salary_df['Payroll Status norm'] == 'paid') &
    salary_df['Cost Centre norm'].isin(lookup_codes)
)

salary_filtered = salary_df[salary_mask].copy()
print("\nSalary filtered count:", len(salary_filtered))
print(salary_filtered[['Payroll Line ID','Cost Centre','Payroll Status','Gross Salary (INR)']].head())

salary_total = salary_filtered['Gross Salary (INR)'].sum()
print("Salary total:", salary_total)

combined = field_total + salary_total
print("Combined total:", combined)

import pandas as pd
import numpy as np

file_path = '/data/national_programme_ledger.xlsx'

field_df = pd.read_excel(file_path, sheet_name='Field Expenses', header=4)
salary_df = pd.read_excel(file_path, sheet_name='Salary Register', header=5)
lookup_df = pd.read_excel(file_path, sheet_name='Cost Centre Lookup', header=3)

# Normalize lookup codes
lookup_codes = set()
for code in lookup_df['Cost Centre Code'].dropna():
    norm = str(code).strip().lower()
    lookup_codes.add(norm)

def normalize_cc(val):
    if pd.isna(val):
        return ''
    return str(val).strip().lower()

def normalize_status(val):
    if pd.isna(val):
        return ''
    return str(val).strip().lower()

# Clean numeric columns
field_df['Amount (INR)'] = pd.to_numeric(field_df['Amount (INR)'], errors='coerce')
salary_df['Gross Salary (INR)'] = pd.to_numeric(salary_df['Gross Salary (INR)'], errors='coerce')

field_df['Cost Centre norm'] = field_df['Cost Centre'].apply(normalize_cc)
field_df['Posting Status norm'] = field_df['Posting Status'].apply(normalize_status)
field_df['Transaction ID norm'] = field_df['Transaction ID'].astype(str).str.strip()

field_mask = (
    field_df['Transaction ID norm'].str.startswith('FE-') &
    (field_df['Posting Status norm'] == 'posted') &
    field_df['Cost Centre norm'].isin(lookup_codes)
)

field_filtered = field_df[field_mask]
field_total = field_filtered['Amount (INR)'].sum(skipna=True)
print("Field total:", field_total)

salary_df['Cost Centre norm'] = salary_df['Cost Centre'].apply(normalize_cc)
salary_df['Payroll Status norm'] = salary_df['Payroll Status'].apply(normalize_status)
salary_df['Payroll Line ID norm'] = salary_df['Payroll Line ID'].astype(str).str.strip()

salary_mask = (
    salary_df['Payroll Line ID norm'].str.startswith('PAY-') &
    (salary_df['Payroll Status norm'] == 'paid') &
    salary_df['Cost Centre norm'].isin(lookup_codes)
)

salary_filtered = salary_df[salary_mask]
salary_total = salary_filtered['Gross Salary (INR)'].sum(skipna=True)
print("Salary total:", salary_total)

combined = field_total + salary_total
print("Combined total:", combined)
print("Field count:", len(field_filtered), "Salary count:", len(salary_filtered))
